rules.description:
You may add units to your Army List from the “Chaos Space
Marine Arsenal” document.

selectionEntries.comment: CURRENT CONFIGURATION: automatically present in every roster. The player chooses Not Included (default) or Included. Included exposes the Great Traitors’ Arsenal section. If the player switches back to Not Included while an Arsenal unit is already selected, the selected unit remains visible and reports a constructive error until removed or the Arsenal is re-enabled.

selectionEntryGroups.comment: CURRENT STATE SELECTOR: mandatory Not Included / Included choice. Not Included is the default; Included exposes the Great Traitors’ Arsenal unit section.

selectionEntries.name: Additional Copy Costs

modifiers.value: Additional Copy Costs is automatically managed by the listbuilder and should appear only once. Remove any extra Additional Copy Costs entries.

selectionEntries.comment:
CURRENT ADDITIONAL COPY COSTS: permanent required host-owned accounting entry with Troops and Other children. Native Troops use the 4 / 6 / 8 normal-copy allowance and native Other uses 1 / 2 / 3. Imported Great Traitors’ Arsenal units are charged here rather than importing a second CSM accounting Configuration.
FRESH INITIATES: the attached Khorne Berzerkers unit is zeroed through its real Butcher Surgeon association, but the separate accounting Configuration cannot reliably query that roster-scope association in New Recruit. The Troops ledger therefore uses one selected Butcher Surgeon as the legal-roster proxy for one exempt Khorne Berzerkers occurrence, refunding at most one +20 surcharge once the active threshold is crossed. The refund may therefore appear as soon as Butcher Surgeon is selected, before an attachment is assigned; that intermediate state is already illegal, while every legal roster resolves to the correct cost. Butcher Surgeon is Rare, max one, and must attach to Khorne Berzerkers, so the proxy is exact for legal rosters.
The parent retains automatic insertion, Required Additional Copy Costs Configuration, and duplicate-entry validation.

selectionEntries.name: Troops
selectionEntries.comment:
CURRENT TROOP COPY-COST LEDGER: Khorne Berzerkers and Jakhals use the 4 / 6 / 8 normal-copy allowance. Fresh Initiates exempts one Khorne Berzerkers occurrence by refunding one +20 surcharge at raw counts 5 / 7 / 9 for 800 / 1200 / 1600 respectively whenever a Butcher Surgeon is selected. This selection-count proxy is used because roster-scope association queries are not reliable from the separate Additional Copy Costs Configuration. The refund can therefore appear before the Butcher Surgeon is attached; that transient roster is already illegal, and the final legal roster cost is correct.
Imported Cultists and the Legionaries family use the same 4 / 6 / 8 thresholds. Replenished Ranks retains the imported CSM one-copy Chaos Apothecary exemption.

selectionEntries.name: Other
selectionEntries.comment: CURRENT OTHER COPY-COST LEDGER: Red Butchers and Eightbound use the 1 / 2 / 3 normal-copy allowance. The same host-owned ledger accounts for the 20 imported generic non-Rare CSM Other families. Existing mode-aware Daemonkin refund modifiers are retained so Master of Possession exempts Possessed or Warp Talons as appropriate.

rules.name: Patch Notes
rules.description:
## World Eaters 3.3.4

• Butcher Surgeon: 130 → 70 Points.

*Full patch notes and rules can be found in the Reforged Discord Server: https://discord.gg/BpjkaNmMVB*

## Catalogue Bugfixes (September 12th)

• Eightbound: Heavy Chain Glaive remains visible on all models; taking more than one now produces a corrective error.
• Eightbound: Exalted Eightbound and Icon of Khorne now use checkbox-style upgrade selections.
• World Eaters Chaos Lord: Glorious Jump Pack now uses a checkbox-style Paid Wargear selection.
• Icon of Khorne now uses checkbox-style Paid Wargear selections across all eligible units.
• Red Butchers and Eightbound: optional third models now use checkbox-style Additional Model selections.
• Butcher Surgeon: Fresh Initiates now correctly exempts its attached Khorne Berzerkers unit from Additional Copy Cost counting.
• Catalogue maintenance: internal implementation comments were consolidated and updated to reflect the live GS21 and Great Traitors’ Arsenal architecture.

selectionEntries.comment:

REV14 updated the Patch Notes rules baseline to World Eaters 3.3.4 and Butcher Surgeon 130 → 70 Points.
REV15-REV19 accumulated the Heavy Chain Glaive, checkbox-style Unit Upgrade / Paid Wargear, and Additional Model presentation fixes.
REV20 updates the heading to September 12th, appends the Fresh Initiates Additional Copy Cost runtime fix and comment-maintenance note, and preserves all prior confirmed bullets.

selectionEntries.comment:
CURRENT FRESH INITIATES: the Khorne Berzerkers unit attached to Butcher Surgeon adds 0 Points to the Army List, including the paid Icon of Khorne descendant through the host association. That exempt unit also does not consume one of the 4 / 6 / 8 normal Troop copies. Because the separate Additional Copy Costs Configuration cannot reliably query roster-scope associations in New Recruit, its one-copy surcharge refund uses selected Butcher Surgeon count as a legal-roster proxy; the refund may appear before the attachment is assigned, but an unattached Surgeon is already illegal and every legal roster resolves correctly. Actual unit-cost zeroing remains association-based.
WORLD EATERS 3.3.4: Butcher Surgeon costs 70 Points (changed from 130 in REV14).

catalogue.comment:
CURRENT STATE — WORLD EATERS 3.3.4 / GS21
Great Traitors’ Arsenal is live through the reusable Chaos Space Marines 3.3.5 Arsenal Library (targetId 21eb-113e-8367-c075, importRootEntries=false). The automatically present Great Traitors’ Arsenal Configuration defaults to Not Included; Included exposes 28 World Eaters-local entryLinks. If the switch is returned to Not Included while an imported unit is selected, that unit remains visible and reports a constructive error until removed or the Arsenal is re-enabled.
Additional Copy Costs is host-owned. Native Khorne Berzerkers and Jakhals use the Troop 4 / 6 / 8 normal-copy allowance; Red Butchers and Eightbound use the Other 1 / 2 / 3 allowance. Imported Arsenal Troops and Other units are accounted for by this same World Eaters entry rather than importing a second CSM accounting Configuration.
Fresh Initiates sets the attached Khorne Berzerkers unit and its paid Icon of Khorne descendant to 0 Points through the real Butcher Surgeon association. Its Troop copy-cost exemption is handled separately in Additional Copy Costs: New Recruit does not reliably expose roster-scope association counts to that Configuration entry, so a selected Butcher Surgeon is used as the legal-roster proxy for one exempt Khorne Berzerkers occurrence. This means the surcharge refund can appear immediately when Butcher Surgeon is selected, before the attachment is assigned; an unattached Surgeon is already an illegal roster state, and every legal roster resolves to the correct cost. The refund is capped at one +20 surcharge because Butcher Surgeon is Rare, limited to one, and must attach to Khorne Berzerkers.
World Eaters Chaos Lord normally attaches to Legionaries, Khorne Berzerkers, Cultists, or Chosen; Glorious Jump Pack switches the required host to Raptors. Eightbound Heavy Chain Glaive uses permissive-corrective max-one validation: all choices remain visible and selecting more than one produces a constructive error. Simple optional Unit Upgrades, Paid Wargear, and the optional third models on Red Butchers and Eightbound use direct max-1 checkbox-style selections.

AUTHORING / RUNTIME NOTES
- Source-derived unit and datasheet rules mirrored from the authoritative PDF are preserved verbatim in their rules[].description fields. Do not editorially correct their capitalization, spelling, punctuation, or grammar unless the authoritative PDF changes.
- Imported Arsenal units retain their library-owned intrinsic semantics; World Eaters owns local presentation, gating, attachment eligibility, and copy-cost accounting.
- Legacy objects explicitly marked LEGACY ID SHELL are intentional compatibility/history objects and should not be deleted merely because they are inert.
- New Recruit runtime behavior is the authority for presentation and query behavior. In particular, roster-scope association queries are not relied upon from the separate Additional Copy Costs Configuration.
- Lightning Claw appearing in both exclusive Chaos Lord weapon lists is an intentional shorthand for the paired-claw state.

HISTORICAL BUILD NOTES — SUPERSEDED
Pre-REV4 Phase 0.1 established the initial native roster, variable-size units, loadouts, Additional Copy Costs, constructive errors, and a placeholder Great Traitors’ Arsenal state before the reusable CSM Arsenal library existed. Those placeholder instructions, old GS11/GS12 references, temporary Raptors-unavailable behavior, and Heavy Chain Glaive cross-hiding behavior are historical only and were superseded by later revisions.

REVISION HISTORY
REV4 — NEW RECRUIT EXPORT COMPATIBILITY
Updated to Game System revision 12 and New Recruit’s canonical Points cost type 51b2-306e-1021-d207.

REV5 — RETROSPECTIVE POLISH PASS
Applied the mature presentation standard to implemented World Eaters units: explicit model headers, standardized Terminator Chaos Lord package naming, specialist model identities, Additional Model naming, Exalted Eightbound under Unit Upgrade, and constructive-error wording. The then-placeholder Arsenal state remained historical until REV7.

REV6 — GS17 TROOP COPY COSTS
Adopted unified Troops / Other Additional Copy Costs. Khorne Berzerkers and Jakhals use the 4 / 6 / 8 Troop allowance; Red Butchers and Eightbound retain 1 / 2 / 3 Other arithmetic. Added the intended Fresh Initiates one-copy Troop exemption.

REV7 — GREAT TRAITORS’ ARSENAL PILOT
Linked the reusable CSM Arsenal library and exposed 28 portable generic CSM units through World Eaters-local entryLinks. Added host-side visibility, Additional Copy Cost accounting, Chaos Lord imported-host eligibility, and Glorious Jump Pack → Raptors attachment behavior.

REV8 — JAKHAL LOADOUT / EXPORT FIX
Collapsed Jakhal Dishonoured to the atomic Skullsmasher Mace & Chainblade final state. Reworked Jakhals 3-10 export handling while preserving surviving IDs and retaining superseded standalone objects as legacy shells.

REV9 — KHORNE BERZERKER LOADOUT CLEANUP
Collapsed Berzerker Champion and Berzerker 2 to atomic final-state loadouts. Consolidated Berzerker 3-5 to Berserker Chainblade & Bolt Pistol with a canonical 3x export target; superseded standalone weapon objects remain legacy shells.

REV10 — GREAT TRAITORS’ ARSENAL CONFIGURATION FIX
Made Great Traitors’ Arsenal automatically present with mandatory Not Included / Included state. Unselected imports hide while disabled; already-selected imports remain visible and receive a constructive error.

REV11 — GS20 TROOP RULE + JAKHAL FIXED PACKAGE
Updated to Game System revision 20, retargeted native Troops to the short-form Troop copy-cost rule, and represented Jakhals 3-10 as one literal 8x Jakhal Chainblades package.

REV12 — STANDARD PATCH NOTES
Added the automatically present Patch Notes Configuration and the player-facing Catalogue Bugfixes section.

REV13 — ARSENAL LINK LABEL SYNC
Refreshed the human-readable Arsenal catalogue-link label while preserving the stable target catalogue ID.

REV14 — WORLD EATERS 3.3.4 / BUTCHER SURGEON COST
Updated the rules baseline to World Eaters 3.3.4, changed Butcher Surgeon 130 → 70 Points, moved to Game System revision 21, and refreshed the Arsenal link label.

REV15 — EIGHTBOUND HEAVY CHAIN GLAIVE PERMISSIVE-CORRECTIVE FIX
Removed Heavy Chain Glaive cross-hiding. All three options remain visible; a hidden semantic category and unit-level constructive error enforce max one.

REV16 — BUGFIX LOG CLEANUP
Rebuilt the player-facing Catalogue Bugfixes list for the September 10 maintenance baseline. Later revisions retain that list cumulatively.

REV17 — EIGHTBOUND CHECKBOX UPGRADE PRESENTATION
Flattened Exalted Eightbound and Eightbound Icon of Khorne to direct max-1 checkbox-style selections while preserving their existing IDs, costs, rules, and constraints.

REV18 — WORLD EATERS CHECKBOX WARGEAR CLEANUP
Extended direct checkbox-style Paid Wargear presentation to Glorious Jump Pack and Icon of Khorne on all eligible native units.

REV19 — ADDITIONAL MODEL CHECKBOXES
Moved the existing max-1 constraints onto Red Butcher 3 and Eightbound 3 so New Recruit renders the optional third models as checkbox-style Additional Model selections while preserving model IDs, costs, nested loadouts, and Heavy Chain Glaive semantics.

REV20 — FRESH INITIATES ACC RUNTIME FIX + COMMENT CONSOLIDATION
Replaced the non-functional roster-scope Butcher Surgeon association query in the separate Troop Additional Copy Costs ledger with the proven roster selection-count proxy. The 800 / 1200 / 1600 refund thresholds remain 5 / 7 / 9 raw Khorne Berzerkers respectively, and the refund remains capped at one +20 surcharge. Actual Fresh Initiates zero-point behavior on the attached Khorne Berzerkers unit and Icon of Khorne remains association-based and unchanged. Audited and consolidated authoring comments around the live GS21, Great Traitors’ Arsenal, checkbox, and Fresh Initiates implementations; removed duplicated per-import Arsenal comments and superseded current-state instructions without deleting intentional legacy-shell history. Updated Catalogue Bugfixes to September 12th and appended the REV20 maintenance entries.
